resolved.title: {check} is back up
resolved.passing: Checks are passing again. Nothing left to do.
resolved.leadDuration: It was down for {duration}. Nothing left to do.
resolved.deletedPreheader: {check} was deleted, so its incident was closed.
resolved.deletedBody: The check was deleted, so this incident was closed. It did not necessarily recover.
resolved.textBody: The incident for {check} has been resolved.

escalated.subject: {check} is still down, escalated
escalated.preheader_one: Still down after {count} failed check, so it was escalated.
escalated.preheader_other: Still down after {count} failed checks, so it was escalated.
escalated.title: {check} is still down
escalated.lead: Nobody acknowledged it in time, so it was escalated.
escalated.textBody: The incident for {check} has been escalated.

reopened.title: {check} is down again
reopened.preheader: {check} went down again after a brief recovery.
reopened.lead: It recovered briefly, then failed again.
reopened.leadRelapses_one: It recovered briefly, then failed again ({count} relapse so far).
reopened.leadRelapses_other: It recovered briefly, then failed again ({count} relapses so far).
reopened.textBody: The incident for {check} has been reopened after a brief recovery.

comment.subject: {author} on {check}
comment.preheader: {author} left a note on the {check} incident.
comment.title: {author} commented on {check}

acknowledged.title: {actor} is on {check}
acknowledged.preheader: {actor} picked it up. Escalation stopped, the incident is still open.
acknowledged.lead: Escalation stopped. The incident stays open until checks pass again.
acknowledged.textBody: {actor} acknowledged the incident for {check}. Escalation has stopped: nobody else needs to pick this up.
acknowledged.textBodyVia: {actor} acknowledged {via} the incident for {check}. Escalation has stopped: nobody else needs to pick this up.
acknowledged.textStillOpen: The incident is still open: acknowledging says someone is on it, not that it is fixed.

unacknowledged.title: Nobody is on {check} anymore
unacknowledged.preheader: {actor} withdrew the acknowledgment. The incident is unowned again and escalation resumes.
unacknowledged.lead: {actor} withdrew the acknowledgment. Escalation resumes where it stopped. Pages already sent are not repeated.
unacknowledged.leadVia: {actor} withdrew the acknowledgment {via}. Escalation resumes where it stopped. Pages already sent are not repeated.
unacknowledged.textBody: {actor} withdrew the acknowledgment on the incident for {check}. Nobody is on it.
unacknowledged.textBodyVia: {actor} withdrew the acknowledgment {via} on the incident for {check}. Nobody is on it.
unacknowledged.textResume: Escalation resumes from the step the acknowledgment interrupted, so the pages that already went out are not repeated.

reminder.subject: {check} is still down, nobody is on it
reminder.title: {check} is still down
reminder.textBody: {reminder}. Nobody has taken this incident yet.
reminder.ackStopsReminders: "I'm on it" also stops these reminders.

burnCreated.subject: {policy}: {slo} at {rate}
burnCreated.preheader: {policy} policy fired at {rate}. {budget} of budget left.
burnCreated.preheaderExhausted: {policy} policy fired at {rate}. The error budget is exhausted.

burnCreated.lead: It is spending budget at {rate} the sustainable rate. Not necessarily down right now, but it cannot keep this up.
burnCreated.textBody: The {policy} policy fired: the objective has been spending its error budget at {rate} over the last {long}, and still is over the last {short}.

burnResolved.preheader: Burn rate back under {threshold}. {budget} of budget left.
burnResolved.preheaderExhausted: Burn rate back under {threshold}. The error budget is exhausted.

burnResolved.textBody: Both windows of the {policy} policy have stayed below {threshold} for a full {short}, so the alert has resolved.
burnResolved.notReturned: The budget that was spent is not returned - only the burn rate came back down.

degradedResolved.title: {check} is steady again

degradedResolved.leadDuration: It was unstable for {duration}. Nothing left to do.
degradedResolved.turnedOffText: Degraded detection was turned off on this check, so the open degraded episode was closed. The check did not necessarily recover.
